# cofide_connect_cloud_account_suppression_config (Resource)

Manages the suppression state of a Cofide Connect cloud account, independently of the `cofide_connect_cloud_account` resource. Useful when the cloud account's existence is managed by automatic discovery rather than Terraform: only the `suppressed` flag is managed here, referencing the account by ID. Do not manage this flag both here and inline on `cofide_connect_cloud_account.suppressed`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# ------ Example: ./examples_tmp/resources/cofide_connect_cloud_account_suppression_config ------
terraform {
  required_providers {
    cofide = {
      source  = "cofide/cofide"
      version = "~> 0.9.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "cofide" {}


variable "cloud_account_id" {
  description = "The ID of the cloud account this suppression setting applies to."
  type        = string
  default     = "example-cloud-account-id"
}


# Useful when the cloud account's existence is managed by automatic
# discovery rather than Terraform: only the suppressed flag is managed here,
# referencing the account by ID.
resource "cofide_connect_cloud_account_suppression_config" "example" {
  cloud_account_id = var.cloud_account_id
  suppressed       = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_account_id` (String) The ID of the cloud account this suppression setting applies to. Cannot be changed after creation.
- `suppressed` (Boolean) When true, discovery is suspended for this account and existing discovered resources are hidden from findings.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource. Matches `cloud_account_id`.
